fields.label: Stage
fields.description: e.g. Proto, Fit, Lab Dip, Size Set, PP Sealer, TOP. Must be unique within this template - depends_on references other rows by this exact text.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: JSON list of stage_name values within this same template, e.g. ["Fit"]. Empty means this stage may start immediately - parallelism is the default, no flag needed.

fields.label: Dependency Type
fields.description: Blocking: version creation is refused while any dependency is unsatisfied. Advisory: allowed, but flagged with a warning and logged on the version.

fields.label: Owner Role
fields.description: Default owner resolution when a plan is created from this template.

fields.label: Default TAT (days)
fields.description: Used to seed planned_date on the Sample Stage created from this row.

fields.label: Mandatory
fields.description: Blocks the style from being marked production-ready if this stage is not Closed - Approved.

fields.label: Applies To
fields.description: PoC keeps this as a style-level stage even for Material-type rows (lab dips etc) - see the module's material-sample exception note. Reserved for the future shared-record model.
